title: US stocks today: US stocks end lower as oil, yields raise September jitters
summary: US stocks started September lower as rising oil prices and Treasury yields heightened inflation and rate concerns. Renewed U.S. strikes on Iranian targets pushed crude higher, while a global bond selloff lifted yields. Markets now price a 68.2% chance of a Fed hike this month.

title: Healthy consumption:  GST collections surge to Rs 2 lakh crore, car sales jump 36%
summary: India's economic indicators showed resilience and growth in August. Goods and services tax collections rose 14.8 percent to ₹2 lakh crore. Bulk car sales surged 36 percent, and UPI transactions reached a new record. Power consumption increased 12.9 percent, signaling economic momentum. These figures reflect healthy consumption and improving compliance across the nation.

title: Why High Yields on Government Bonds Are Causing Alarm
summary: Government borrowing costs have been surging around the world as investors demand more compensation to entice them to hold longer-maturity debt.
